description: An XREFFILE that exists and holds no row: the only way to reach FILE STATUS '10' on the FIRST READ at :93, which drives the :98 arm, MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT at :99, the 88 APPL-EOF condition at :63 in its TRUE state and MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE at :108 before a single record has been displayed. The PERFORM UNTIL at :74 therefore runs exactly one iteration, and both halves of the doubled DISPLAY are suppressed on it: :96 sits inside the XREFFILE-STATUS = '00' arm that the end-of-file READ does not take, and the guard at :77 withholds :78. The observable output is the two banners alone, which is the n = 0 end of the 2 + 2n line count every clean case obeys, so a translation that displayed before testing the status would emit a third line here and nowhere else. An empty dataset is a positive statement - the file was opened and read - and is not the same as a case that never mentioned the dataset.
